scope: Read-only design audit of additive finite DATA-only currentSassToolReferenceSubject batch and actual table/legacy call sites. No implementation or execution.
verdict: Conditionally sound under stated non-stable callback count and noncontinuous observation contract, if operation-level snapshot, all finite predicates and same-object ownership are preserved. No present implementation or measured speedup is assessed.
actual_side_contract: ownsReference returns false on unsupported/malformed metadata and consults authenticated identities; side first captures plain full incoming object, validates metadata, returns null on unknown path or digest, matches optional length, freshly reads actual current row.after using member, returns copied incoming with selected before/after hash and conditional size, checks original incoming equals its snapshot, then sweeps physical bound.

comparisonBytes rejects unsupported reference, returns a fresh Buffer copy of authenticated immutable historical identity, validates its optional size, freshly reads actual current row.after, checks incoming snapshot and sweeps full physical bound. No returned comparison buffer is a current reader or admission capability.

member obtains physical bytes, checks current bound digest/size, compares supplied Buffer intrinsically, rechecks physical bytes after callback, and matches requested current after identity. Full guard has additional planner identity check, but ordinary side methods are not an assertCurrent substitute.

Side early null currently occurs before member and sweep; a batch requiring an initial full sweep even for unsupported request is stricter and changes failure timing. Document this additive API rather than claiming identical arbitrary-reader trace.
conditions: Validate and snapshot the finite request list plus every request and full plain reference before any caller-supplied callback; reject proxies/accessors/cycles/holes consistently with the intended request schema. Preserve all extra reference fields, optional bytes behavior, per-kind return/null/throw behavior, request order and duplicate independent checks.

Run full current bound physical sweep before any request callback; for EACH actually owned request perform the genuine current target member physical/supplied/physical and after identity check; use original exact ownership and requested before/after/comparison semantics. Do not group away duplicate per-request source reads.

Recheck every captured incoming request after all callbacks, not merely the request just processed: a later callback can mutate an earlier reference or request array. Perform live full bound final physical sweep after the last callback; no successful partial result escapes before completion.

Ensure active same-subject batch reentry is either protected by a finally-reset operation lock or proven safe against live request/result redirection; enforce existing guardNode consumption locks when a callback reenters it, without granting external reader authority. Preserve exception identity and no success after thrown supplied reader.

Output detached metadata objects and fresh immutable historical comparison Buffer copies only; do not return current raw bytes, current read routes, result reuse handles, or cached assertions. Scope results to this specific batch call, do not share by identical path/value across subject instances.

Table/legacy constructors may batch only statically known requests for the SAME actual current-tool instance. Their frames and repairs transformations, ownership decisions, intermediate expected digests and every direct physical/current source read remain genuine; dynamic requests dependent on callback-derived earlier values must wait or be excluded. Direct precomputed result cannot bypass table/legacy qualify, predecessor, comparison, registry or source owner checks.
sampling_counterexample: Old A side sweep, then B callback temporarily changes A-only bound source and restores before B final: batched endpoints may miss if the change is entirely between samples; old A sweep may or may not see it depending on timing. This change in observation windows is acceptable only within the expressly accepted no-continuous-observation contract; no claim of equivalence under arbitrary callback mutation or exact call order. A B callback leaving A-only source changed is caught by final sweep.
meaningful_tests: Stable ordered reference cases for before/after identities, omitted or supplied bytes, optional/extra fields, unknown and malformed refs, null versus throw and duplicate requests; compare against real individual operations on same genuine subject.

Actual cold bound corruption restored by first callback; later callback changing an earlier bound path, and immediate same-target physical change returning old/new/forged or non-Buffer bytes; require path/phase proof and no false-positive self assertions.

Request mutations including earlier reference or array by later callback, getter/proxy attempts, distinct same-path independent subjects, nested same-instance use and recovery after reader throw; ensure no partial result leaked.
Exercise concrete table/legacy constructor before/after semantic equivalence and full source CLIs at original deadlines after profile pins refresh.
limits: The sampled profile indicates repeated side sweeps in actual stacks; it does not establish wall-time reduction or full-owner completion. Current 21 browser regression timed out and cannot be treated as passed.
